description: This file defines the GatewayAutostartPolicy enum containing static methods to determine gateway startup and launch agent conditions based on application state.

methods.name: shouldStartGateway
methods.description: Determines if the gateway should start based on connection mode and paused state.

methods.name: shouldEnsureLaunchAgent
methods.description: Determines if the launch agent should be ensured, delegating to shouldStartGateway.
